title: expiredprocess
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): activestageid, createdbyname, createdonbehalfbyname, knowledgearticleid, modifiedbyname, modifiedonbehalfbyname, organizationid, processid, transactioncurrencyid.

activestagestartedon.description: Date and time when current active stage is started.

businessprocessflowinstanceid.description: Unique identifier for Expired Process bpf entity instances

completedon.description: Date and time when Business Process Flow instance is completed.

createdon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was created.

duration.description: Duration the business process flow was active.

exchangerate.description: Shows the conversion rate of the record's currency.

importsequencenumber.description: Unique identifier of the data import or data migration that created this record.

modifiedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was last updated.

overriddencreatedon.description: Date and time that the record was migrated.

statecode.description: Shows whether the Delve action record is pending, completed, or tracking.

statuscode.description: Select the delve action record status.

versionnumber.description: Version number of the business process instance.

_activestageid_value.description: Unique identifier of the active stage for the Business Process Flow instance.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who created the record on behalf of another user.

_knowledgearticleid_value.description: Unique identifier of the workflow associated to the Business Process Flow instance.

_modifiedby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record on behalf of another user.

_organizationid_value.description: Unique identifier of the organization with which the SDK message request is associated.

_processid_value.description: Unique identifier of the workflow associated to the Business Process Flow instance.

_transactioncurrencyid_value.description: Choose the local currency for the record to make sure budgets are reported in the correct currency.
